final_claim: For the fully self-including, normalized residual two-token map with V=diag(lambda,-M), lambda>0, M>lambda, q=tanh(kappa), the positive consensus sinks iff eta<2/(M-lambda). The synchronized e2 sign-flip is a sink iff eta>2/(M-lambda); the antipodal sign-flip is a sink iff qM>lambda and eta>2/(qM-lambda). At eta=2/(M-lambda), the full synchronized circle is pointwise fixed by the second iterate and normally attracting, with normal multiplier cos^2(2theta)/A^2 and A=(M+lambda)/(M-lambda).
